entities.name_native: BMLUK Abteilung V/8 Strahlenschutz (Aufsichts- und Bewilligungsbehörde)
entities.name_en: Federal radiation protection / nuclear supervisory authority (BMLUK Dept. V/8)
entities.notes: Austria has no NPP; this ministry department is the national radiation-protection/nuclear-emergency authority (research reactor supervision). Mail domain is the whole environment ministry.
